basis: Frozen before implementation (D4, D7). Observations are the pinned seed interpreter output recorded by regen.py; cases hold reviewed literals. Nothing is derived from Knot.

commands.wrapper: import <fixture, relative to the wrapper> as F; def main() -> F.<result>: F.<entry>(F.<arg>{}, ...)

requirements.agree: Knot checks the fixture (exit 0), and for every call in observations its evaluator and its emitted Wasm return the recorded result tag.
requirements.agree-or-unsupported: Either agree, or exit 3 with an Unsupported diagnostic and no artifact. Invalid (exit 2) is never acceptable: the seed accepts.
requirements.unsupported: Exit 3; stderr starts with the pinned diagnostic; no artifact is written.
requirements.reject: Never Checked or Built; no artifact is written. With exit pinned, only that outcome class qualifies; with diagnostic pinned, stderr starts with it. Otherwise exit 2 or 3.

cases.name: lambda-apply
cases.intent: A lambda and a named definition flow into one function-typed parameter, called through a bound variable.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: return-closure
cases.intent: gate returns a closure over its parameter, applied as gate(k)(x), through an inferred let, and as an annotated let-bound lambda.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: compose
cases.intent: compose captures two closures and returns a third; a composition is itself composed and applied.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: nested-capture
cases.intent: Three nested lambdas read a let-bound capture and both outer binders; a lambda binder shadows a parameter, and x => x => x returns its second argument.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: choose-thunks
cases.intent: The S.choose idiom with u => thunks: split gives each thunk its own affine capture; shared captures one + value in both thunks and nests a choose; staged ends in a thunk whose body is a +m let followed by a call, as in src/patterns.bend.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: choose-promoted
cases.intent: The S.choose idiom over a match arm, as in src/lex.bend: the field binder +a is promoted, so both thunks and a nested choose capture it; the plain field b is captured once.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: bind-continuation
cases.intent: The S.bind idiom over a fixture Res: Fail short-circuits the continuation, and the inner lambda reads the outer +x binder.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: curried-continuation
cases.intent: A continuation of type Flag -> Flag -> Color -> Color, fed x => y => z => (as in src/patterns.bend), applied spread as next(a, b, c) and stepwise as next(a)(b)(c).

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: generic-choose-bind
cases.intent: The exact signatures of S.choose and S.bind over fixture types; choose is instantiated at Color and at the function type Flag -> Flag, and bind at two distinct type arguments.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: closure-field
cases.intent: A closure capturing k and a named definition are stored in a field of a Type datatype, unpacked by a match and applied.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: closure-list
cases.intent: A recursive Type list of closures (named, capturing and identity) is consumed front to back; each closure runs exactly once.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: cps-fold
cases.intent: Continuation-passing parity folds over a user list: walk grows its continuation per element; nested descends from inside a continuation lambda, as src/patterns.bend does.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: partial-application
cases.intent: Definitions applied to fewer arguments than parameters: pick(a) of two, paint(a, b) and paint(a) of three, the last passed to a curried parameter.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: closure-in-arm
cases.intent: Match arms return different closures; the Tagged arm lambda captures the field bound by its pattern.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: defunc-sites
cases.intent: One apply site receives a capture-free lambda, lambdas with one and two captures, a named definition, a partial application and a returned closure.

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: curried-arities
cases.intent: gate(k, x) over-applies a one-parameter definition that returns a closure; next(x) under-applies a curried closure variable, returning a closure.

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: erased-closure-arg
cases.intent: A lambda passed to an erased -f parameter captures x while x is also passed live; a returned closure uses its erased capture only as an erased argument.

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: closure-drop
cases.intent: An affine closure is built and never applied; a closure parameter is applied in one arm and dropped in the other, or applied once in each arm.

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: lambda-reusable-binder
cases.intent: A +y lambda binder at the Data type Flag is used twice in a constructor, as in S.bind(..., +reference => ...); a plain g binder at the function type Flag -> Flag, the argument of the second-order parameter of lift, is applied once.

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: partial-self-call
cases.intent: walk(t) is a partial self-call whose supplied argument already shrinks; the seed accepts it (an S2 exit gate).

knot.justification: Seed-valid adversarial program inside increment 7; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: template-map
cases.intent: map written as a template: ~f is substituted per call site, so it may be used at every element.

knot.justification: Seed-valid, but templates are S3; the first unsupported form is the ~f binder in the parameter list of map, which src/parse.bend, the src/SPEC.md table and tests/subsets/classification-cases.json (template.bend) name template-binder.

cases.name: do-block
cases.intent: do-notation over a fixture monad desugars into Opt.bind calls with continuation lambdas and an Opt.pure return.

knot.justification: Seed-valid; do desugaring enters at S3, so increment 7 may report it Unsupported, but never Invalid (D4).

cases.name: dependent-arrow
cases.intent: A parameter of the erased dependent function type @-A: Type -> A -> A, fed A => y => y and applied at Flag.

knot.justification: Seed-valid dependent function type that src/ does not use; increment 7 may defer it as Unsupported, never Invalid (D4).

cases.name: lambda-match
cases.intent: The seed lambda-match \{On: Off{}; Off: On{}} passed as a function value.

knot.justification: Seed-valid closure sugar that src/ does not use; increment 7 may cover it or report the \{ term Unsupported, never Invalid (D4).

cases.name: closure-call-twice
cases.intent: f(f(x)) applies an affine function-typed parameter twice.
seed_reason:
- observed : f (consumed more than once)
Location: twice

knot.justification: A function-typed parameter is affine; its second application is affine-reuse, the existing code.

cases.name: closure-twice-data
cases.intent: A closure whose only capture is the Data value +k is applied twice through a let.
seed_reason:
- observed : g (consumed more than once)
Location: bound

knot.justification: A closure is affine even when all its captures are Data (the S2 exit gate "reject closure duplication"); the second use of g is affine-reuse.

cases.name: capture-affine-twice
cases.intent: Two thunks capture the same affine a; building both consumes it twice, although only one runs.
seed_reason:
- observed : a (consumed more than once)
Location: shared

knot.justification: Captures count when the closure is built: two captures of affine a are affine-reuse, whichever thunk runs.

cases.name: capture-field-twice
cases.intent: choose-promoted without the +: the affine field binder a is captured by two thunks.
seed_reason:
- observed : a (consumed more than once)
Location: promoted
29>|     case Pair{a, b}:

knot.justification: A field binder without + is affine like a parameter: two captures of a are affine-reuse, whichever thunk runs.

cases.name: capture-then-use
cases.intent: An affine k is captured by a let-bound lambda and then used again after it.
seed_reason:
- observed : k (consumed more than once)
Location: annotated

knot.justification: The capture consumes k; its later live use is affine-reuse.

cases.name: map-reuses-function
cases.intent: map applies one closure parameter to the head and passes it to the recursive call.
seed_reason:
- observed : f (consumed more than once)
Location: map

knot.justification: f is affine, so using it for the head and again in the self-call is affine-reuse; mapping needs a list of closures, a continuation or a template.

cases.name: reusable-function-param
cases.intent: A + binder on a function-typed parameter, to apply it twice.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: twice

knot.justification: Function types are Type, never Data; a + binder at a non-Data type is reusable-type, the existing code.

cases.name: reusable-closure-binder
cases.intent: The lift of lambda-reusable-binder fed a +g binder, whose type is the function type Flag -> Flag, to apply it twice.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: main
lift(+g => g(g(On{})))

knot.justification: A + lambda binder obeys the parameter rule: its type Flag -> Flag is Type, so reusable-type.

cases.name: function-field-data
cases.intent: A function-typed field in a Data datatype.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: Fn

knot.justification: A Data declaration may hold only Data fields and a function type is Type; the structural checkpoint names this data-field-kind.

cases.name: erased-capture-live
cases.intent: A returned closure yields its erased capture w live.

knot.justification: Capturing does not make an erased binder live; returning w from the lambda body is erased-live, the existing code.

cases.name: lambda-matches-binder
cases.intent: A lambda body matches the lambda's own binder.
seed_reason:
- message  : a match on a parameter or field (this name is a def or a consumed binder: give the value its own def)
7>|   y => match y:

knot.justification: Only definition parameters and fields are scrutinees; tests/compiler-checker/fixtures/match-after-let.bend pins the same seed reason as unmatchable-binder.

cases.name: lambda-matches-capture
cases.intent: A lambda body matches a definition parameter it captures.
seed_reason:
- message  : a match on a parameter or field (this name is a def or a consumed binder: give the value its own def)
12>|   y => match x:

knot.justification: Inside a lambda body a captured parameter is no longer a scrutinee; tests/compiler-checker/fixtures/match-after-let.bend pins the same seed reason as unmatchable-binder.

cases.name: apply-non-function
cases.intent: A call headed by a variable of the enum type Flag.
seed_reason:
- expected : a function type
- observed : Flag
Location: run

knot.justification: A bound variable whose type is not a function type stays not callable; tests/compiler-checker/fixtures/local-shadow-call.bend pins the same seed reason as not-callable.

cases.name: closure-over-applied
cases.intent: f: Flag -> Flag receives two arguments, so f(x) is applied as a function.
seed_reason:
- expected : a function type
- observed : Flag
Location: apply

knot.justification: Closure application is increment 7, so Knot must report Invalid; the second application could be named call-arity or not-callable, so the code is open.

cases.name: closure-domain-mismatch
cases.intent: A Color -> Color definition is passed where Flag -> Flag is expected.
seed_reason:
- expected : @_:Flag -> Flag
- observed : @c:Color -> Color
Location: main

knot.justification: Function types are compared by domain and codomain; Color -> Color against Flag -> Flag is a type mismatch.

cases.name: unannotated-let-lambda
cases.intent: A let-bound lambda without a type annotation.
seed_reason:
- expected : an annotated term (cannot infer)
Location: annotated

knot.justification: A lambda cannot be inferred; an unannotated let initializer that needs its type is annotation-required, the existing code.

cases.name: lambda-forward-call
cases.intent: A lambda body calls a definition declared below the enclosing definition.
seed_reason:
- expected : a filled definition
- observed : later
Location: by_lambda

knot.justification: A live call inside a lambda body is still a live call of the enclosing definition; a call to a later definition is forward-live-call.

cases.name: partial-self-same
cases.intent: walk(xs) is a partial self-call whose supplied argument does not shrink.
seed_reason:
- expected : a decreasing self-call (arguments are read left to right: each passed unchanged until one shrinks)
- observed : walk
Location: walk

knot.justification: A self-call that fails the descent rule is Unsupported recursive-call, as tests/compiler-recursion pins for same-parameter; a partial self-call is still a self-call.
